In [[functional analysis]], a discipline within [[mathematics]], the '''Szász–Mirakjan–Kantorovich operators''' are defined by

:<math>[\mathcal{T}_n(f)](x)=ne^{-nx}\sum_{k=0}^\infty{\frac{(nx)^k}{k!}\int_{k/n}^{(k+1)/n}f(t)\,dt}</math>

where <math>x\in[0,\infty)\subset\mathbb{R}</math> and <math>n\in\mathbb{N}</math>.<ref name="Walczak">{{cite journal|last=Walczak|first=Zbigniew|year=2002|title=On approximation by modified Szasz–Mirakyan operators|journal=Glasnik Matematički|volume=37|issue=57|pages=303–319|url=http://web.math.hr/glasnik/vol_37/no2_08.html}}</ref>
